statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229
The denial reason code was CO-197
The denial was because required prior authorization was not obtained
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The dizziness and giddiness are clinically consistent with hemodynamic instability secondary to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for continuous ambulatory assessment
The monitoring was ordered to evaluate the correlation between symptomatic episodes and underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic changes
The diagnosis codes submitted were I34.0 and R42
